title: Safer updates
summary: Only checked versions install, recipes and settings are copied before each update, updates wait while the drives are in use, and a version that makes the drives worse goes back by itself.

changes.title: Only checked versions can be installed
changes.description: A version appears as "Not checked yet" until the release check on GitHub has passed it.

changes.title: Copy of recipes and settings before every update
changes.description: Go back can put the recipes and drive settings from before the update back. Nothing is lost: the newer ones are kept in a copy.

changes.title: Updates wait while the drives are in use
changes.description: Install, Restart and Go back wait while a recipe runs or drive settings are being written.

changes.title: Health check after an update
changes.description: If the drive controller or drives stop answering after an update, the previous version is put back by itself.

upgradeNotes: Before the first update to this version, set up the release check on GitHub (see README), or untick "Only install versions that passed the release check" in Update settings.
